findings.summary: Existing SME lending: EUR 2300.0m across 10000 borrowers; energy data coverage 65% (3500 unresolved).

The supplied control is performed per new credit application and its stated coverage excludes the existing portfolio. It therefore does not evidence recurring ESG monitoring for Northstar's existing SME book. The 65% attributed energy-data coverage also leaves 3,500 borrowers unresolved.
